title: Prewarm Engram control sidecar outside request budget
outcome: ProcessEngramControlTransport lazily spawns the control process inside the first 250 ms adapter call. Cold or loaded hosts can spend the whole budget starting the process, causing a false degraded card and backoff before the protocol request runs.
acceptance: Enablement and rebind arming establish sidecar readiness outside the per-call budget; the first bind/evaluate deadline measures protocol response only; lifecycle and failure cleanup remain bounded and tested.
disposal_reason: NOT PLANNED (backlog triage w-930e4d333f07, 2026-10-05; Greg's approval via Engram::Advisor #293). P3/P4, never started, no holder or children, untouched since before 2026-09-21, not reliability, data safety or pilot. The record is kept; reopen or re-file if it becomes relevant.
